headline: Models couple transcriptome, chromatin, genome and spatial context to resolve cell-state dynamics
label: Single Cell Dynamics And Multimodal
summary: New preprints link scRNA, scATAC, scHi-C and spatial data via optimal transport, VAEs and transformers, alongside simulators for benchmarking dynamic methods.
synthesis: The dominant thread is joint modeling of single-cell state dynamics across modalities and context. COATI uses unbalanced synchronized optimal transport to infer coupled scRNA and scATAC trajectories across held-out stages. scHiR embeds paired scRNA-seq and scHi-C with a hyperspherical VAE, and MUSS links DNA sequence, scATAC peaks and expression. Spatial work separates signal sources: DisCell distinguishes intrinsic state, niche response and neighbor spillover, spOT-NMF applies optimal transport for deconvolution, and SpaAxFormer models gene-resolved states across neighbors. Simulators (scCircaSim, scDeepSim) enable controlled benchmarking, and a prior-knowledge analysis relates perturbation predictability to Perturb-seq structure. LingoCell adds language-guided in silico perturbation. PhysInfer, scCont and scSLIDE are adjacent, addressing bursting, EMT programs and sample-level trajectories.
